name: herdr-graph-engineering
description: Graph engineering on Herdr: one orchestrator chat runs each idea as a lane (a worktree running a small graph of agent, gate and person steps) until its definition of done, and comes to you only when a lane needs you. Requires the herdr plugin, jq, yq and git.

interface.shortDescription: One chat; every idea becomes a lane of agents in Herdr.
interface.longDescription: Give ideas to one orchestrator chat. Each becomes a lane: a Herdr worktree running a small graph from a pattern (implementer then tests, an investigator, ...). Scripts decide which steps are ready, run gate commands and record results with bounded retries; the orchestrator checks evidence and asks you only when a lane needs you. Requires the herdr plugin, jq, yq and git.
